origin.description: Version 2 with compress none matches saveRDS. gzip is compared after it is opened.

arguments.name: x
arguments.text: The data, path, or collector this function accepts.

origin.details: Version 2 with compress none matches saveRDS. gzip is compared after it is opened.
origin.value: The same value readr 2.2.0 returns for this case, written as one line in the output.
origin.example:
df <- data.frame(a = c(1, NA), b = c(TRUE, NA), c = c("x", NA), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
path <- "/tmp/readr-write.rds"
gz <- "/tmp/readr-write.gz.rds"
write_rds(df, path)
write_rds(df, gz, compress = "gz")
raw <- readBin(path, "raw", file.info(path)$size)
packed <- memDecompress(readBin(gz, "raw", file.info(gz)$size), "gzip")
paste0(paste(sprintf("%02x", as.integer(raw)), collapse = ""), " ",
       paste(sprintf("%02x", as.integer(packed)), collapse = ""))

translation.description: Version 2 with compress none matches saveRDS. gzip is compared after it is opened.

arguments.name: x
arguments.text: The data, path, or collector this function accepts.

translation.details: Version 2 with compress none matches saveRDS. gzip is compared after it is opened.
translation.value: The same value readr 2.2.0 returns for this case, written as one line in the output.
translation.example:
import gzip
df = frame(["a", "b", "c"], [[1.0, None], [True, None], ["x", None]])
path = Path("/tmp/readr-write.rds")
gz = Path("/tmp/readr-write.gz.rds")
write_rds(df, path)
write_rds(df, gz, compress="gz")
return path.read_bytes().hex() + " " + gzip.decompress(gz.read_bytes()).hex()
